record.paper_title: Research Problems on Relations Between Nijenhuis Geometry and Integrable Systems
record.original_question: Find exact solutions of BKM systems by integrating system (12) beyond quadratures, for example in terms of elliptic or other special functions.

evidence.quote: Problem 2.2. Find exact solutions of BKM systems.
One can try to go further and look for exact solutions of BKM systems using elliptic or other special functions.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Background. Let $M$ be a smooth manifold and let $L$ be a (1,1)-tensor field on $M$, called a Nijenhuis operator, whose Nijenhuis torsion
\[
\mathcal{N}_L(X,Y) := L^2[X,Y] - L[LX,Y] - L[X,LY] + [LX,LY]
\]
vanishes identically. Assume $L$ has, at a generic point, pairwise distinct real eigenvalues $\lambda_1(x),\dots,\lambda_n(x)$ serving as local coordinates. The associated BKM (Bolsinov–Konyaev–Matveev) system is the quasilinear evolutionary PDE system on the eigenvalues
\[
\partial_t \lambda_i \;=\; f_i(\lambda_1,\dots,\lambda_n)\,\partial_x \lambda_i, \qquad i=1,\dots,n,
\]
together with the compatible higher symmetries and conservation laws inherited from the Nijenhuis structure. (Equivalently, the BKM system is the multicomponent integrable PDE system obtained by writing the natural Nijenhuis-geometric flow in eigenvalue coordinates; its specializations include the KdV, Camassa–Holm, Dullin–Gottwald–Holm, Kaup–Boussinesq, Ito, coupled KdV, coupled Harry Dym, and multicomponent Camassa–Holm equations.)

Problem. Construct explicit exact solutions of BKM systems by integrating the underlying ODE system beyond quadratures. In particular, exhibit families of solutions expressible in terms of elliptic functions (Jacobi or Weierstrass) or other classical special functions, and characterize the class of BKM systems for which such closed-form solutions exist.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as a research problem in the literature on Nijenhuis geometry and BKM systems. Web search returns the problem-list document itself and a recent (2025) preprint on Lax pairs for the BKM hierarchy, but no source providing a complete construction of exact solutions of generic BKM systems in terms of elliptic or other special functions beyond quadratures. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Research problems on relations between Nijenhuis geometry and integrable systems
status_evidence.snippet: Lists exact solutions of BKM systems as a research problem, suggesting elliptic or other special functions.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is stated as an open research problem.

status_evidence.title: Lax pairs for BKM hierarchy
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work providing Lax pairs for BKM hierarchy but not delivering closed-form elliptic-function solutions of general BKM systems.
status_evidence.claim: Recent related progress exists but does not resolve the exact-solutions problem.
